name: Blue Ice Melt Channel
description: The product standing in a meltwater channel carved into the flank of a deep blue glacier, live water running past it in a glassy tongue that breaks white at the lip, ancient trapped air standing in ranks in the ice wall behind. Everything here is wet and moving — the ice is working plumbing, not a display case.
